# Vendor Info: idb-keyval

- **Project**: [Promise-based IndexedDB storage](https://github.com/jakearchibald/idb-keyval)
- **Version**: 6.3.0
- **License**: Apache-2.0
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/idb-keyval)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `vendor/updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Select **idb-keyval** from the dropdown menu.
3. Click "Download" and select this local directory (`vendor/idb-keyval/`) when prompted.
4. The tool will automatically update this `_VENDOR-INFO.md` file.
5. Update the version number in the root [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md).
